title: Stagebench three-phase Nord Stage 4 evaluation rubric

anchors.0: Missing, broken, disconnected, contradicted by direct evidence, or not exercised.
anchors.1: Minimal, placeholder, substantially incorrect, or presentation-only where behavior is required.
anchors.2: Partially complete with important fidelity, depth, or integration gaps.
anchors.3: Strong and substantially complete against the assigned phase contract with limited gaps.
anchors.4: Exceptional fidelity, behavior, integration, and evidence against all assigned references.

1.name: Complete surface and basic piano
1.description: Scores the complete reference-faithful surface, exact playable keybed, one dependable basic Piano voice, honest decorative-control boundary, and engineering reliability.

criteria.label: Silhouette, chassis, and geometry
criteria.guidance: Compare canonical desktop capture with the assigned variant: continuous red chassis, deck/keybed ratio, exact keybed, end cheeks, rails, and section widths.

criteria.label: Complete hardware inventory and placement
criteria.guidance: Check all six sections, stable control inventory, density, landmarks, and that Program/Synth are the only primary OLED locations.

criteria.label: Materials, color, typography, and displays
criteria.guidance: Assess red metal, dark panels, control materials, legends, branding, LEDs, OLEDs, shadows, and hierarchy.

criteria.label: Narrow retention
criteria.guidance: Check complete chassis/keybed, no clipping or lost controls, usable inspection, and legible state at 390x844.

criteria.label: Unified playable inputs
criteria.guidance: Exercise pointer, multitouch, computer keyboard, and MIDI through one note lifecycle including focus/MIDI failure cleanup.

criteria.label: Voice lifecycle and performance
criteria.guidance: Exercise velocity, release, repeat/overlap, sustain input, polyphony/stealing, and automatic blur/disconnect/unmount cleanup. Visible panel controls remain decorative.

criteria.label: Basic source and status honesty
criteria.guidance: Require a dependable audible Piano-like voice and truthful source, ready/loading/error, fallback, and provenance claims; multiple Piano instruments are not required.

criteria.label: Control movement and feedback
criteria.guidance: Exercise keys, wheels, knobs, encoders, faders, drawbars, and buttons; every visible input must move/press and expose deliberate accessible state.

criteria.label: Decorative-control boundary
criteria.guidance: All visible panel knobs, buttons, wheels, faders, drawbars, and encoders are presentation-only in Phase 1 and must not falsely claim or appear to alter audio/system state. Only keybed note/sustain input is real.

criteria.label: Data structure and tests
criteria.guidance: Assess stable IDs, normalized hardware data, input/audio separation, meaningful candidate tests, and maintainable React/TypeScript.

criteria.label: Runtime quality
criteria.guidance: Assess technical checks, console state, loading, cleanup, responsiveness, and repeated interaction stability.

2.name: Piano library and working effects
2.description: Scores multiple distinct Piano instruments, detailed Piano performance behavior, a connected shared audio graph, representative effect families, and inherited visual quality.

criteria.label: Surface fidelity retention
criteria.guidance: Compare Phase 2 with reference and Phase 1 capture for geometry, inventory, keybed, materials, and responsive drift.

criteria.label: Piano/effect hardware state
criteria.guidance: Piano and effect controls must show coherent focus, on/bypass, target, parameter, and display state through the physical surface.

criteria.label: Distinct sampled Piano instruments
criteria.guidance: Require at least three bundled recorded sample sets covering grand, upright, and electric/electromechanical character, with audible distinctions, offline playback, and redistributable file/root/velocity provenance. Generated primary buffers do not satisfy this criterion.

criteria.label: Two-layer Piano behavior
criteria.guidance: Exercise enable, focus, level, selection, octave, layering, voice ownership, and cleanup for both Piano layers.

criteria.label: Detailed Piano controls
criteria.guidance: Verify velocity/touch, timbre, resonance, release, unison, dynamic compression, and supported pedal behavior change canonical and audible state.

criteria.label: Input and fallback reliability
criteria.guidance: Recheck all input paths, sustain/soft/sostenuto support, rapid play, asset failure, truthful fallback, and stuck-note prevention.

criteria.label: Shared graph and gain staging
criteria.guidance: Verify one AudioContext, per-layer buses, ordered effect path, master gain/limiter, one destination, automation, and cleanup.

criteria.label: Audible effect coverage
criteria.guidance: Exercise real Mod 1, Mod 2, Delay, Amp/EQ or filter, Compressor, Reverb, and Rotary processing. Labels or disconnected nodes score 0.

criteria.label: Routing and control
criteria.guidance: Verify focus/targeting, bypass, wet/dry, effect order, Delay feedback path, Reverb-before-Rotary, and physical parameter bindings.

criteria.label: Audible/visible feedback
criteria.guidance: Selections and parameters must produce immediate coherent display, LED, control, and sound feedback.

criteria.label: Failure and stress behavior
criteria.guidance: Exercise denied MIDI, failed assets, rapid effect changes, layered polyphony, focus loss, clipping, and recovery.

criteria.label: Audio architecture
criteria.guidance: Assess source/voice/layer/bus/effect/master boundaries, injectable platform APIs, and Phase 3 extensibility.

criteria.label: Real-boundary tests
criteria.guidance: Inspect deterministic tests that measurably prove source, control, effect, routing, bypass, and cleanup behavior across the actual backend boundary.

criteria.label: Performance and maintainability
criteria.guidance: Assess duplication, naming, cleanup, render/audio stability, load behavior, and inherited regression coverage.

3.name: Complete Stage 4 system
3.description: Scores complete Programs/performance workflows, distinct Organ and Synth engines, full hardware bindings, inherited Piano/effects integration, and final-system reliability.

criteria.label: Reference and regression retention
criteria.guidance: Compare final capture with reference and prior phases for chassis, geometry, inventory, materials, and responsive drift.

criteria.label: Complete hardware state fidelity
criteria.guidance: Check Programs, splits, scenes, morphs, Organ, Synth, effects, focus, routing, LEDs, and displays through reference-credible hardware state.

criteria.label: Programs, presets, and Live Mode
criteria.guidance: Exercise canonical round-trip, browse, Store/Store As, categories, dirty/cancel/undo, Program buttons, presets, and eight Live slots.

criteria.label: Layers, splits, scenes, and morphs
criteria.guidance: Exercise editable zones/splits/crossfades, two scenes, Wheel/Aftertouch/Control Pedal assignment/interpolation, focus, clock, transpose, and Panic.

criteria.label: Complete Organ system
criteria.guidance: Exercise two layers, six models, drawbars/registers, percussion, key click, vibrato/chorus, presets/live state, focus/zones, and Rotary.

criteria.label: Complete Synth system
criteria.guidance: Exercise three layers, Samples/Analog/Extern, source families, Osc Ctrl, filters, envelopes, LFO, voice modes, glide/unison/vibrato, arp, and gate.

criteria.label: Distinct engine behavior
criteria.guidance: Verify Organ models and Synth source families have meaningfully distinct exercised spectra/time behavior, not renamed generic oscillators.

criteria.label: Inherited graph and effects integration
criteria.guidance: Verify all engines use inherited buses/effects/targeting/Rotary/master path with one destination and correct gain staging.

criteria.label: Musical quality, latency, and load
criteria.guidance: Exercise layered/split play, clicks, clipping, latency, voice limits, arp timing, cleanup, CPU stability, and useful sound quality.

criteria.label: Canonical state round-trip
criteria.guidance: Programs/presets must restore supported Piano, Organ, Synth, effects, routing, splits, scenes, morphs, focus, and display state.

criteria.label: Required hardware bindings
criteria.guidance: Audit every required Phase 3 control for meaningful canonical and audible behavior; generic no-op fallbacks score 0.

criteria.label: Cross-system workflows
criteria.guidance: Exercise engines with layers, zones, splits, scenes, morphs, presets, effects, clocks, focus, and displays as one system.

criteria.label: Inherited regression reliability
criteria.guidance: Confirm complete surface, inputs, Piano library, effects, audio cleanup, and responsive behavior remain functional.

criteria.label: System architecture
criteria.guidance: Assess canonical state ownership, engine boundaries, one-context routing, effect composition, serialization, and extensibility.

criteria.label: Tests and maintainability
criteria.guidance: Assess meaningful inherited and real-boundary tests, naming, modularity, duplication, documentation, and required-control coverage.

criteria.label: Runtime performance
criteria.guidance: Assess console state, cleanup, memory/voice behavior, render stability, audio load, and rapid integrated interaction.
